question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        AVG(composition / index_value) AS avg_index_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE (_year = 2018.0 AND _month >= 9.0) OR (_year = 2019.0 AND _month <= 8.0)
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_index_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_index_composition DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT mm.month_year, mm.interest_id, mm.avg_index_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM monthly_max mm
    WHERE mm.rn = 1
),
ordered_top AS (
    SELECT 
        tpm.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(tpm.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(tpm.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
        ) AS month_num
    FROM top_per_month tpm
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        ot.month_year,
        ot.interest_id,
        ot.max_index_composition,
        ot.month_num,
        AVG(ot.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY ot.month_num 
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(ot.interest_id, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ot.month_num) AS prev_1_interest_id,
        LAG(ot.interest_id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY ot.month_num) AS prev_2_interest_id,
        LAG(ot.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY ot.month_num) AS prev_1_max_index_composition,
        LAG(ot.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY ot.month_num) AS prev_2_max_index_composition
    FROM ordered_top ot
)
SELECT 
    wl.month_year AS date,
    im.interest_name,
    ROUND(wl.max_index_composition, 4) AS max_index_composition,
    ROUND(wl.rolling_avg_3m, 4) AS rolling_average,
    im_prev1.interest_name AS prev_1_interest_name,
    ROUND(wl.prev_1_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev_1_max_index_composition,
    im_prev2.interest_name AS prev_2_interest_name,
    ROUND(wl.prev_2_max_index_composition, 4) AS prev_2_max_index_composition
FROM with_lag wl
LEFT JOIN interest_map im ON CAST(wl.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im_prev1 ON CAST(wl.prev_1_interest_id AS INTEGER) = im_prev1.id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im_prev2 ON CAST(wl.prev_2_interest_id AS INTEGER) = im_prev2.id
ORDER BY wl.month_num
